params.prompt: Editorial macro photograph of a tilt-shift miniature diorama on a clean light grey desk, HO-scale model figurines in neat business clothes, soft natural daylight, calm, precise and friendly mood, very tidy composition, white paper, light grey, graphite details, turquoise #30D5C8 as the only accent colour, no logos. Four neat stacks of papers in a row with small printed signs «СТРУКТУРА», «ОБЛІК», «ПОДАТКИ», «БАНКИ». Tiny auditors work at each stack: one measures with a ruler, one checks a column of numbers through a magnifying glass, one marks a line with a turquoise highlighter, one compares a bank statement with a receipt. A tiny figure carries a clipboard titled «ПЛАН ДІЙ» toward the viewer.
